annotations.title: Check whether AI crawlers are blocked in robots.txt

description: Use this when someone asks why their site never shows up in AI answers, or whether GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot or Google-Extended can crawl it. Reads the site's robots.txt and reports which of those crawlers are blocked, including by a blanket rule the owner may not have meant. One fetch, no AI.

url.description: The site or page URL to check. A bare domain like example.com is fine.

name: check_ai_crawler_access
title: Check whether AI crawlers are blocked in robots.txt
